title: Orbit simulator
description: Plot a spacecraft’s motion around massive bodies with an early BASIC gravity simulation.
versionOrder: Inferred from source changes and tape11b save order: six labeled forms, with later forms adding adaptive scale and setup options. The v1–v4 and v5–v6 groups are parts of the same simulator. Some latest menu branches are unfinished historical code; completeness of cassette recovery is separate from runtime behavior.
